gpu_tip: ~40GB total at 128K context — the full-precision build, and with all 40 of Granite's layers on full attention the f16 KV cache alone is ~21GB at that length. It is a dense model, so every layer that spills to system RAM costs real speed: a 24GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4090) plus a 32GB DDR5 kit runs it via llama.cpp's layer offloading. The quantized builds below leave much more headroom.
mac_tip: Needs ~40GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) comfortably.
